clips.start_words: So meditation transcends a specific meditation technique
clips.caption:
You keep filling the balloon with hot air and it won't lift off the ground. More effort isn't the problem.

You're still tied down by sandbags — the energetic imprints weighing on your field that no amount of positive thinking burns off. Untie the ropes and you might rise an inch. Cut the sandbags loose, the ones built from years of unprocessed emotion and programming, and that's when you actually leave the ground. Manifesting works the exact same way.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to find yours.
